title: Sysdig Adds Runtime Security and Governance for AI Agents
description: Sysdig announced Sysdig AI Defense, a runtime security and governance platform designed to monitor and control AI agents' actions in real time. The platform provides visibility into AI agent behaviors, detects risky or unauthorized actions, and can block such actions before they impact production systems. It addresses the challenge of autonomous AI agents acting faster and more complexly than human oversight can manage, offering audit-quality records and policy enforcement aligned with frameworks like the OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications.
